description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and four different types of code-related resources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” is linear and spans from 10 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, which is unlabeled but scaled numerically, ranges from 20 to 40 and features tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and rises to about 41. The red line, representing Library Documentation, begins near 28, peaks at around 42, and ends near 41. The green line, representing Github files, starts at about 29, rises to a peak of approximately 42, and then slightly declines to around 41. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, begins at approximately 34, dips to around 31 near 400 tokens, and continues to decline to about 28 by 800 tokens.
